notes.title: Dev Update 1
notes.notes:
Gameplay Updates
Lilac - Visual Update

Our crystallized mole just got a glow-up! Lilac has a brand-new look and is ready to shine on the battlefield!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/f18695007134338d7667543841cd0b98e7ece608.gif

Sid- Skill Rework

Sid has undergone intense training and has enhanced his fire-spitting ability! Soon, you’ll get to experience the most powerful flamethrower around!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/704c256b46d1603f20f9be8de2e22d02d6a150a3.gif

Traits

Choosing your squad just got even more strategic with the arrival of Traits! Now, you can benefit from relationships, characteristics, and even elemental affinities shared among your squad members! Each character has three unique traits! Ready for some spoilers?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/1cd4f2a0fe5f61d051b4aa763ba60f7f9f15da52.png

🔹 Bouncy: Dex + Hop Hop 
The power of jumping when you need it the most! Whenever you take damage, your main character will leap to gain an advantage!

🔹 Sisters: Kiara + Blip
Sisterhood is precious! With our feline duo united, they can occasionally use each other's abilities!

🔹 Crystal: Lilac + Edge + Blip + ???
Harness the power of the crystal element in your team and summon swirling crystal dust whenever you defeat corrupted enemies, dealing damage and slowing them down!


New Lands!

After exploring the Kashmyr Archipelago and the Nimbus Forest, you will now venture into the Shadowweave Village and then the One-Eyed Road! The challenges in these two new maps are insane (and fun)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/d4d9d91bed971dfcaf82a4ae8397acc2219d0724.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/3a6fe16cf5196d0c3fd2574f5573802ebeb16bfd.gif

Relics

Sid’s grandfather, the legendary Sidolfus, has a knack for uncovering rare and powerful relics! After overcoming certain challenges, he’ll be able to retrieve these mystical artifacts, each carrying a unique effect to aid you in battle.

Our goal is to bring you around 100 different relics, allowing endless possibilities for creative and strategic builds! And, of course, we won’t leave you in the dark—we've got some exciting spoilers coming your way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/e53b2cdedbab8e4498bc57babaf311d4134d617f.png

🟢 Soap Amulet – Healing bubbles will appear when you take damage!
🔥 Charred Bone – Summons a blazing canine ally to fight by your side! [strike](Maybe you've seen him around 👀)[/strike]
💥 Glass Cannon – Increases the damage you deal, but also the damage you take!


That's all for today! Enjoyed the spoilers? Stay tuned for more exciting updates coming soon, [strike]especially for those who love playing with a friend![/strike]

notes.title: Shard Squad Demo Update v0.4
notes.notes:
⚡ New Squad Member: Nana, the Electric Star! ⚡
"Welcome the most electrifying member of the squad! 💫 Nana is ready to shock a legion of fans (including her beloved Sid!) with her energetic groove! Get ready to dance with our Electric Star! 🎶⚡"

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/14173acc94e989ce6d8983f26b47366b4ecf4936.gif

🌲 New Level Unlocked! 🌧️
Welcome to Nimbus Forest! 🌿 Once a peaceful forest, this rainy land is now cursed by the wailing of the calamity Zarudam! 🌩️ Lightning and thunder await the bravest squad members! ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45317685/3d2b27b824c68b7ee02d26b123175f5c41ffd089.png

⚖️ Game Balance Update!
We've made some difficulty adjustments! Let us know what you think! 📢🎮

🎮 Controller Support!
You can now play Shard Squad with your favorite controller! 🕹️🔥 Give it a try!

🖥️ New In-Game Interface!
We've updated the game's visuals! ✨ Feel free to share your thoughts! 💬
